title: Interactive Web Applications
description: 2D simulations, cellular automata, and other experiments. Built in pure JavaScript and rendered on the HTML canvas with no external libraries.
description_short: A collection of modern web applications.

Ropes.info: An interactive rope simulation built from scratch in JavaScript using Verlet integration. Explore physically simulated ropes, constraints, and real-time interaction through a lightweight custom engine.
Ropes.info_short: An interactive rope simulation built from scratch in JavaScript using Verlet integration.

Falling Sand.info: A falling-sand sandbox simulation featuring over fifty unique materials and emergent interactions. Includes a controllable character capable of shooting particles, creating dynamic and often unpredictable simulations.
Falling Sand.info_short: A cellular automata featuring emergent interactions between materials.

Logic Gates.info: A visual node-based logic simulator where digital circuits can be assembled and evaluated in real time. The same node system can also be used to build experimental audio synthesis graphs.
Logic Gates.info_short: A visual node-based logic simulator drawn on an HTML canvas.

Marbles.info: A lightweight, relaxing physics playground built around marble interactions. Experiment with collisions, gravity, and momentum inside a simple but satisfying simulation.
Marbles.info_short: A fun and relaxing simulation built around marble interactions.
